description: DoughMatrix engines as agent-callable tools. Sourdough: true-hydration math (counts water inside the starter), flour hydration ceilings, 4-factor DDT water temperature, temperature-calibrated bulk fermentation windows, and over-pour rescue. Pricing: true batch cost (ingredients + labor + overhead over sellable units) turned into margin/markup prices, variant deltas, and order profit. Free, no key.
name: doughmatrix-sourdough
notes: True hydration counts the starter's flour and water — most recipes quote baker's % which hides starter water. The API returns both.
Danger levels: safe / caution (within 4 points of the flour's ceiling) / danger (at or over ceiling).
GET /calculate accepts the same fields as URL query params for zero-friction calls.
No authentication, no rate limits published — be reasonable; this is a free pilot.

Pricing state is nested (products with ingredient/variant lists), so pricing_calculate takes the full state in the POST body; GET /api/pricing/calculate prices the sample products with overridable defaults.

tools.description: Compute a complete sourdough formula: flour/water/starter/salt weights, true vs baker's hydration, flour-ceiling safety margin, DDT water temperature, bulk fermentation window with fold schedule, and a step-by-step timeline. All inputs optional — omitted fields use sensible defaults (500g bread flour, 72% true hydration, 20% inoculation, 24°C dough).

blendId.description: Optional second flour blended in; set blendPercent > 0 to activate.

blendPercent.description: Blend flour as % of flour weight (0-80). Default: 0.

doughTempC.description: Desired dough temperature °C — drives DDT water temp and bulk timing. Range 10-34. Default: 24.

doughWeightTarget.description: Target dough weight in grams; only used when mixMode is 'dough'. Default: 900.

flourId.description: Flour from the catalog — see sourdough_flours. Unknown IDs fall back to bread flour. Use 'custom' with customName/customProtein/customCeiling for your own mill. Default: bread.

flourTempC.description: Flour temperature °C, for DDT calc. Default: 21.

frictionC.description: Mixer friction factor °C (0 for hand mixing). Default: 1.

loafCount.description: Number of loaves; splits dough weight per loaf. Default: 1.

maturity.description: Starter maturity — young needs a longer bulk, late a shorter one. Default: peak.

mixMode.description: Mix by flour weight or target dough weight. Default: flour.

roomTempC.description: Room temperature °C, for DDT calc. Default: 22.

saltPercent.description: Salt as % of total flour. Range 0.5-4. Default: 2.

starterHydration.description: Starter hydration % (100 = equal weights flour and water). Default: 100.

starterTempC.description: Starter temperature °C, for DDT calc. Default: 23.

starterWeight.description: Ripe starter/levain weight in grams. Default: 100.

targetTrueHydration.description: Target TRUE hydration % — total water / total flour including the starter's flour and water. This is the headline number; baker's % is also returned. Range 50-110. Default: 72.

tools.name: sourdough_calculate
tools.outputDescription: Returns the normalized input, the full formula (weights, trueHydration, bakerHydration, ceiling, danger level safe/caution/danger, margin to ceiling, DDT waterTempC, bulk window minH/targetH/maxH with fold schedule, autolyse/reserve water split), a timeline of mix/fold/shape/proof/bake events, and a plaintext summary.

tools.description: List the flour catalog behind the engine: id, name, protein %, hydration sweet spot and ceiling %, family, and notes. Use an id as flourId/blendId in sourdough_calculate.
tools.name: sourdough_flours
tools.outputDescription: Returns { flours: [{ id, name, short, protein, sweetSpot, ceiling, family, notes }] }.

tools.description: Price baked goods from true batch cost: ingredients + packaging + your labor + overhead, divided by the units that actually sell (yield minus waste). Returns per-product unit cost, the suggested price for a target margin after channel fees, the markup-frame price, profit/margin at the current price, per-variant prices (variants are per-batch cost deltas, not new recipes), and whole-order profit after the real card fee. All inputs optional — omitted fields use the sample products (chocolate chip cookies + a sourdough loaf) and defaults ($18/hr labor, 40% target margin).

defaults.description: Business defaults applied to every product.

markupPercent.description: Markup % for the side-by-side markup price. Default: 100.

targetMarginPercent.description: Target gross margin on price %, after channel fees. Default: 40.

order.description: Order lines for the profit-per-order view. variantIndex is an index into the product's variants, or null for the base product.

products.description: Products to price. Each is costed per batch.

channelFeePercent.description: Fee this product's sales channel takes from the price %. Default: 0.

currentPrice.description: Price currently charged $, for the profit/margin check. Default: 0.

ingredients.description: Ingredient rows. Row cost = amountUsed × purchasePrice ÷ purchaseQty; amountUsed and purchaseQty must share a unit (g/g, count/count).

overheadPerBatch.description: Overhead $ per batch (oven energy, booth share, utilities). Default: 0.

variants.description: Variants as per-batch cost deltas on the base product.

wastePercent.description: Waste / unsold % of the batch. Cost divides by sellable units only. Default: 0.

tools.name: pricing_calculate
tools.outputDescription: Returns the normalized input state, per-product results (batch/unit math, suggested margin price, markup price, profit/margin at the current price, variant table), whole-order profit after card fees, and a plaintext summary.

tools.description: Over-pour rescue: too much water went into the bowl. Given the same inputs as sourdough_calculate plus extraWater (grams), returns how much extra flour and salt restores the target true hydration, plus the new dough weight and true hydration.

extraWater.description: Extra water accidentally added, in grams (0-2000). Required.

tools.name: sourdough_rescue
tools.outputDescription: Returns the normalized input, the base formula, and rescue: { extraWater, extraFlour, extraSalt, newDoughWeight, newTrueHydration }.
